purpose: resolve whether each modern comparator CVI can be implemented AND independently validated, per the rule that a new implementation must never be validated only against itself
validation_rule: correctness tests must use an official/reference implementation, an author-provided example, a published toy example, or an independent known-good implementation

evidence_gathered.validclust_note: every index it provides is already native to our inventory, so it adds no modern comparator

CDbw.reference: Halkidi & Vazirgiannis (2008), density-based cluster validity using multi-representatives
CDbw.independent_implementation: PyPI package `cdbw` v0.2, MIT licence, single module (8 KB)
CDbw.parameter_policy: must be pinned to the package defaults BEFORE any external outcome is seen
CDbw.validation_route: wrap the MIT package rather than rewrite; verify on deterministic toy partitions and edge cases

CVNN.reference: Liu, Li, Xiong, Gao, Wu (2013), Understanding and Enhancement of Internal Clustering Validation Measures
CVNN.why_blocked: no packaged or reference implementation is available in this environment, so any implementation written from the paper could only be validated against itself, which the validation rule forbids
CVNN.additional_risk: the separation term is normalised across the compared partition set, so an unverified variant would silently change every reported value

CVDD.reference: Hu & Zhong (2019), internal validity index involving density and path-based relative distances
CVDD.why_blocked: no reference implementation and no way to disambiguate between similarly named published variants; the brief requires STOP rather than implementing an uncertain metric

DCSI.reference: Gauss, Scheipl, Herrmann (2024), DCSI - An improved measure of cluster separability based on separation and connectedness
DCSI.why_blocked: the author repository declares NO licence, so it cannot be vendored or redistributed; without it there is no independent reference to validate against
DCSI.possible_unblock: obtain explicit permission from the authors, or find a licensed reimplementation

summary.stop_rule_cited: STOP immediately if any modern CVI cannot be validated against an independent reference; STOP Stage 4B rather than implementing an uncertain metric
summary.what_was_NOT_done: no CVI was implemented from the literature without a validation reference; nothing was guessed
summary.consequence: until resolved, no claim may be made against CVNN, CVDD or DCSI, and the metrics-paper criterion that requires comparison against modern CVIs remains unmet
options_for_project_lead: A. proceed with CDbw only, and state explicitly in the paper that CVNN/CVDD/DCSI were not evaluated
B. obtain the DCSI authors' permission and/or a licensed reference, then implement and validate DCSI
C. supply trusted reference implementations or published worked examples for CVNN and CVDD, which would unblock them under the existing validation rule
D. drop the modern-comparator requirement and rely on the established comparators already in the inventory (DBCV, S_Dbw, silhouette, CH, DB, Dunn, COP, Coggins-Jain)
